versions.content: Unknown Event With development error detection IdsMDev- ErrorDetect enabled, the IdsM module shall check the parameter securityEven- tId of the function IdsM_ReportSecurityEvent against the configured security events, and shall report the development error IDSM_E_PARAM_INVALID when an unknown event ID is provided by the service call. An unknown event is an event that has not been configured in IdsMEvent.c
